angle: Five repos, all free, all with more stars than most companies have users
caption:
Star counts are a popularity contest, but at this scale they tell you something real: these are the tools enough people found useful that they came back to bookmark them. Every one is free and installs in a single command.

🔖 Save this — the links are all free.
➡️ Follow @profit_prompts_ for the AI stack that actually pays.

#github #opensource #aitools #developers #freetools

slides.text: A star is someone bookmarking a repo to come back to. At six figures, that is a lot of people who found it worth returning to.

slides.caption: what OpenClaw gained in a matter of days after going viral

slides.title: Start with Ollama
slides.body: One command pulls a model and runs it locally. No account, no key, no per-token bill. It is the lowest-friction way to find out whether local AI is good enough for what you do.

slides.title: Then pick one more
slides.body: Installing five tools in a weekend means learning none of them. Take the one that maps to a job you already do badly, and give it a fortnight.

slides.text: You won't see this anywhere else
